title: Titans trade defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons to the Bears for two first-round picks
dek: A 1-6 team sends its best-known defender to a 5-2 team. The price is Chicago's next two first-round picks.
what: The reporter Adam Schefter posted the terms on X on 29 October 2026, citing sources. The Bears receive defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick. The Titans receive first-round picks in 2027 and 2028 and a fourth-round pick in 2027.

NFL.com reports that Tom Pelissero of The Ringer first reported the trade, and lists the same terms. It says Simmons signed a three-year, $105.8 million extension with Tennessee in June 2025, with $100 million guaranteed, and that the Bears are 5-2 and the Titans 1-6.
NFL.com quotes Titans owner Amy Adams Strunk: "There are few people like Jeff Simmons. We are forever grateful for all he has given this team and this city."
Posts in the capture compare the price with other recent defensive trades. I did not find reporting that confirms those comparisons, so they are not part of this story.
why: The price in first-round picks is large, and the two teams are at opposite ends of the standings. Fans of both are weighing what each side gave up.

sources.label: NFL.com: Bears acquire DT Jeffery Simmons from Titans in blockbuster trade
